purpose: Evidence-based selected-path projection repair after R3 recovered command records but not absolute location hints. Selector, fixed file/date scope, byte/resource bounds and cleanup are unchanged.
compressed_scope: Exactly eleven direct-child regular *.jsonl.zst files; no recursion, symlinks, or user-supplied paths.
selection: Buffer-only structural selector requires exact root type=response_item, root timestamp date 2026-10-02, direct payload type=function_call/custom_tool_call and approved exec/exec_command tool name. Unknown direct root/payload fields and their full values are structurally skipped, never UTF-8 decoded or JSON parsed. Duplicate known keys, escaped direct envelope keys, invalid JSON structure/numbers/escapes, unsupported status/call_id kinds and trailing bytes are rejected before selected decoding. No full history object is JSON parsed.
exports: Filename, timestamp, tool name, explicit recordtype, has_invocation heuristic (script or python -m src.data.build_formal_candidate_space_v2) and selected clean metadata path/--output-root/--candidate-root snippets only. No whole commands, environment, credentials, outputs or result fields.
path_caveat: Historical denied-path strings are metadata hints only and may be exported; their files are never accessed. Protected B root and checkpoint/sensitive path strings are suppressed.
format_coverage: Unescaped ASCII selected envelope keys/type/name values; arbitrary legal JSON whitespace/key ordering. Unknown direct fields accepted by structural skip. Any escaped direct root/payload/argument-object key is outside coverage and fails closed without decoding. Duplicate known keys rejected. Maximum structural depth 64. At most 100 retained identities. A command record is not execution proof.
payload_field_gate: function_call requires quoted arguments and forbids input; custom_tool_call requires quoted input and forbids arguments. call_id if present must be quoted string or null; status if present is null or completed/in_progress/incomplete. These known checks occur before any selected decode; other metadata fields are structurally skipped.
coverage: Freeze opened file sizes and scan only initial prefixes; ignore appends. Oversized lines counted and skipped. Bound-hit files and incomplete prefixes explicit; no global history absence claim.
prior_execution_observation: R1 emitted a PASS-looking packet with zero command matches, then a generic FAIL packet and exit 2. Actual post-output failure cause is unknown; double-close is a hypothesis, not established evidence. R1 artifacts and two-line output are preserved.
cleanup: FileHandle objects own input descriptors. Await all handle cleanup before emitting any terminal packet. Cleanup failure emits only one bounded FAIL packet; no success is emitted before cleanup.
diagnostic: Diagnostic projection unchanged from R3: only predefined envelope key/type/tool enums and value kinds; unknown keys are UNKNOWN_KEY. Command selector and selected-string decoding unchanged; only path projection adapted as specified in path_projection.
execution_policy: Independent review before one versioned R4 path-projection run. Same twelve fixed files, date and byte caps; no date/path expansion, automatic retries, network or actual-data access. R1/R2/R3 executed artifacts remain immutable. Implementation tests do not open actual history.
selected_decode: Decode/JSON.parse only the selected quoted timestamp and command string. For exec_command, the selected arguments string is unescaped as a string, then its JSON argument object is structurally scanned for a unique quoted cmd; only that cmd literal is decoded/JSON parsed. No whole argument object is JSON parsed. No unknown root/payload metadata, id, result body or content value is decoded.

adaptation_evidence.observed_projection: Only relative formal_candidate_space_v2_r1 hints; no actual output root recovered.
adaptation_evidence.interpretation: Escaped command-source Windows paths warrant a bounded literal absolute-path projection update, not inferred creation roots or invocation proof.

path_projection: Only selected command strings: normalize backslash runs to one slash, preserve existing clean literal argv roots/metadata names, and project approved absolute path strings whose suffix is ASCII filename/path characters without spaces. Absolute paths are metadata_path_hint only, never asserted actual output roots. Require token boundaries on both sides; embedded URL/foreign-prefix suffixes and invalid suffix continuations are rejected. Quoted candidates must close their quote, preventing truncated quoted-path hints. Maximum twelve clean snippets per record.
path_expression_policy: No evaluation, interpolation, variable lookup, concatenation or filesystem lookup. Literal argv paths may retain argv_output_root/argv_candidate_root roles; variable-based expressions are not bound. Absolute source/executable/base paths are generic hints, not output-root evidence. Existing traversal/protected/BLIND/checkpoint/credential exclusions remain enforced.
